truth_boundaries: All official-domain physics evidence is AimDK v1 MuJoCo simulation, not a real X2 robot run.
IsaacLab sole12 is a declared training domain and is explicitly not claimed numerically equivalent to official MuJoCo.
Contact labels are official-model or simulator geometry/collision estimates, not real foot GRF, COP, wrench, or pressure truth.
No result in this checkpoint proves sim-to-real safety, real-robot deployment, cross-robot generalization, or Any2Any success.
The native Gold asset is one approximately 60 second official-simulator dance sanity trace, not a target-robot AMASS-scale training corpus.

base.quest: Build a reliable speed-backend stop/recovery path without corrupting startup or moving control.
base.physical_progress: recovery promotion gate remains 0/5; 25-update and long training locked

phases.hypothesis: Replacing only recovery_model should isolate recovery performance.
phases.intervention: Read-only Phase9 role-count and routing audit.
phases.result: recovery inference count was 0/episode because curriculum_then_policy hard-coded stationary after handoff; candidate was a strict no-op and was not run.
phases.conclusion: f005 had not actually been tested as an independent recovery role.
phases.next: repair role semantics before any paired gate

phases.kind: role repair plus official paired gate
phases.hypothesis: source stationary can protect startup while f005 owns only post-transition recovery.
phases.intervention: route post-transition authority to recovery slot and synchronize previous/issued action in that slot.
phases.control: source recovery vs f005 recovery, five full official episodes each.
phases.result: role counts were exact 10/10; source/f005 full 0/5 and stop 0/5. f005 stop drift mean improved 0.303 to 0.276 m, but settle time worsened 4.396 to 5.200 s and both collapsed.
phases.conclusion: role semantics are trustworthy; f005 does not promote.

phases.hypothesis: a fixed action discontinuity at handoff precedes delayed collapse.
phases.intervention: align all ten Phase11 traces at stop 2.0 s and measure normalized/physical target jumps and collapse latency.
phases.control: source-recovery five vs f005-recovery five existing traces.
phases.result: physical target L2 jump median 0.434/0.471 rad; tilt crossed after 1.32/1.60 s and root height after 1.92/2.14 s.
phases.conclusion: handoff discontinuity is reproducible and temporally prior, but causality is unproven.

phases.hypothesis: removing the target jump should delay or prevent collapse if it is the dominant cause.
phases.intervention: 0.5 s C2 physical-target blend with exact inverse action/history synchronization; default remains 0.
phases.control: blend 0.0 vs 0.5, five official episodes each.
phases.result: handoff physical target L2 0.420 to 0.000 rad and max per-step 0.420 to 0.026 rad; history error 0. Both groups full/stop 0/5, healthy candidate collapse delayed only about 0.03 s.
phases.conclusion: handoff continuity is fixed as a mechanism, but it is not the sufficient collapse cause and does not promote.

phases.hypothesis: post-handoff recovery inputs leave the Stage335 support domain before collapse.
phases.intervention: robust per-group nearest-neighbor/quantile audit of four healthy Phase13 suffixes against Stage335 and source-stand support.
phases.control: Stage335 90 states and 250 source-stand stable rows.
phases.result: global composite, q, dq, and current-action OOD were 0; previous-action group OOD was 24.67%, first at +0.24 to 0.26 s in 3/4, before gravity/root violation around +1.2 to 1.4 s. Source-stand support was OOD from t=0.
phases.conclusion: global physical-state coverage failure is not supported; rollout-consistent action-history suffix data is the narrower hypothesis, not a proven cause.
phases.next: design closed-loop suffix aggregation instead of adding isolated reset poses

phases.hypothesis: on-policy closed-loop suffixes target previous-action drift better than more isolated reset states.
phases.intervention: default-off recovery-only 0-1.5 s snapshot sidecar, full physical/93D/action/controller hashes, conservative dedup, immutable Stage335 virtual union.
phases.control: suffix_fraction=0 opens no sidecar, consumes no suffix RNG, and keeps Stage335 exact.
phases.result: schema/hash/no-op contracts passed 20 tests; collected suffix rows 0; no official run and no training.
phases.conclusion: collection infrastructure is ready, but effectiveness is unknown and training stays locked.
phases.next: after backup, at most one frozen f005 suffix capture, then offline audit before any smoke

No suffix data has been collected and no suffix-curriculum training result exists.
